Vulnerability.Name: Log4Shell Remote Code Execution
Vulnerability.Description: The self-service portal logs user-controlled input through a vulnerable Log4j 2 version. A crafted User-Agent or form value containing a JNDI lookup string triggers remote class loading and code execution on the application server.
Vulnerability.Remediation: Upgrade Log4j to 2.17.1 or later. Set log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true as an interim mitigation. Hunt application logs for jndi: strings and review outbound LDAP/RMI connections.

Vulnerability.Name: Broken Access Control in Collaboration Suite
Vulnerability.Description: A broken access control flaw lets an unauthenticated attacker create administrator accounts on the trainee portal's collaboration module, taking full control of the instance.
Vulnerability.Remediation: Upgrade to the fixed release. Audit the user table for unexpected administrator accounts created recently. Block the setup endpoints from external networks.

Vulnerability.Name: Missing Anti-CSRF Tokens on Profile Update
Vulnerability.Description: Profile and password-change forms on the trainee portal do not include anti-CSRF tokens. An attacker can host a malicious page that silently changes a logged-in trainee's email or password.
Vulnerability.Remediation: Implement per-session anti-CSRF tokens on all state-changing requests. Set SameSite=Lax on session cookies. Re-prompt for the current password on sensitive changes.
